source.note: Kenney firetruck (FBX like car-sedan, car-van, car-delivery and tractor, same kit and pin, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member, which references that texture). Scaled to a real fire engine: 3.0 m to the light bar, which makes it 6.0 m long and 2.65 m wide (a compact urban pumper is about 3 m tall, 7-9 m long and 2.5 m wide, so Kenney’s toy proportions are a little short and wide). That is about 1.6x the kit cars’ own scale, so it sits at real size beside the tractor rather than the kit-scale cars. Indigo script, consistent with the tractor: red body in the accent with the sky navy as shade; every grey of the colour map (equipment-locker shutters, chassis, bumper, grille, rear shutter) in one sky-navy role with a near-black shade, because the shutters’ light-to-dark gradient shares its greys with the chassis and splitting them left diagonal slivers; windows in the moon tone; roof rails, light-bar centre and locker header strips in the paper white with the moon shade; blue beacons in moon; headlamps in the practical gold; rims paper white; tyres near-black with the navy shade on faces turned away. maxColors 48 so the windows, rims and beacons separate cleanly from the greys. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips, as the other kit cars.
